```{r}
#| label: library-loading
library(tidyverse)
library(RODBC)
library(janitor)

# IPEDS HD: iclevel == 1 is "four or more years"; control 1/2/3 = public / private nonprofit / for-profit.
four_year_control_codes <- c(1L, 2L, 3L)

# After clean_names(), some net price fields appear as npist_2 instead of npist2; map to a single codebook.
normalize_sfa_net_price_cols <- function(df) {
  # was getting repeated errors over these being "not found" so now it just renames all of them to be the same 
  if (!"npist2" %in% names(df) && "npist_2" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(npist2 = npist_2)
  if (!"npgrn2" %in% names(df) && "npgrn_2" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(npgrn2 = npgrn_2)
  if (!"npis412" %in% names(df) && "npis_412" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(npis412 = npis_412)
  if (!"npgr412" %in% names(df) && "npgr_412" %in% names(df)) df <- df |> rename(npgr412 = npgr_412)
  # safety check that fills a required column with NA if it can't be found (shouldn't really be used)
  for (nm in c("npist2", "npgrn2", "npis412", "npgr412")) {
    if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

# Standardized net price from public vs private IPEDS fields, using HD control.
add_net_price_by_control <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      .ctrl = as.integer(control),
      # creates a temporary control variable 
      # use public variable (npist2) if control is 1
      # use private variable (npgrn2) if control is 2
      net_price_avg = case_when(
        .ctrl == 1L ~ npist2,
        .ctrl %in% c(2L, 3L) ~ npgrn2,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      # same logic for the pell proxy variable
      net_price_avg_pell = case_when(
        .ctrl == 1L ~ npis412,
        .ctrl %in% c(2L, 3L) ~ npgr412,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) |>
    # remove the temporary control and the original source columns
    select(-.ctrl, -any_of(c("npist2", "npgrn2", "npis412", "npgr412")))
}


# function for admissions data
# pulls admission rate and raw counts from the ADM table
# DVADM01 is IPED's Percent Admitted Variable
# IPED's uses negative values for missing/na values
clean_adm <- function(df, inst_clean) {
  df |> 
    clean_names() |> 
    semi_join(inst_clean, by = "unitid") |> 
    select(unitid,
           applicants = applcn,
           admissions = admssn,
           admit_rate = dvadm01) |> 
    mutate(admit_rate = if_else(admit_rate < 0, NA_real_, admit_rate))
}
```

# 2019-2020 Data Extraction

```{r}
#| label: 2019-2020-ingestion
#| cache: true
db_path <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS201920.accdb")
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path)

# fetches raw tables from database
# this is a separate step because i was figuring out .accdb files
# combined for all future years
institutional_chars <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2019")
student_financial_aid <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1819_P1")
student_financial_aid_2 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1819_P2")
fall_enrollment_cip <- sqlFetch(con, "C2019_A")
retention <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2019D")

inst_clean_2019 <- institutional_chars |>
  clean_names() |>
  # keep only 4-year schools and valid school types (1,2,3)
  filter(as.integer(iclevel) == 1L, as.integer(control) %in% four_year_control_codes) |>
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr, control)

ret_clean_2019 <- retention |>
  clean_names() |>
  # using semi_join to make sure we only keep schools that survived the inst_clean filter
  semi_join(inst_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf)

aid_p1_clean <- student_financial_aid |>
  clean_names() |>
  semi_join(inst_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  select(unitid, pell_pct = pgrnt_p)

aid_p2_clean <- student_financial_aid_2 |>
  clean_names(numerals = "asis") |> # keep the numbers in the names so selection doesn't break
  semi_join(inst_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  normalize_sfa_net_price_cols() |> # use the helper function
  select(unitid, npist2, npgrn2, npis412, npgr412)

# merging both aid tables
aid_final_2019 <- aid_p1_clean |>
  left_join(aid_p2_clean, by = "unitid")


# calculating hhi 
hhi_2019 <- fall_enrollment_cip |>
  clean_names() |>
  semi_join(inst_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  filter(awlevel == 5) |> # filtering for only bachelor's degrees
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> # get the broad 2 digit CIP codes
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |>
  summarize(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> # calculate % of students in each major
  summarize(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |> # square and sum per the hhi formula 
  ungroup()

# final join into one big 2019 dataset
master_2019 <- inst_clean_2019 |>
  left_join(ret_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(aid_final_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(hhi_2019, by = "unitid") |>
  add_net_price_by_control() |>
  mutate(academic_year = "2019-20")
# closing connection and saving
odbcClose(con)
save(master_2019, file = "../master_2019.RData")
```
All data below follows the exact same steps as above except 2023-24.
# 2020-2021 Data Extraction

```{r}
#| label: 2020-2021-ingestion
#| cache: true
db_path_2020 <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS202021.accdb")

  clean_names() |>

  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf)

  clean_names() |>
  semi_join(inst_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  select(unitid, pell_pct = upgrntp)

aid_p2_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1920_P2") |>
  clean_names(numerals = "asis") |>
  semi_join(inst_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  normalize_sfa_net_price_cols() |>
  select(unitid, npist2, npgrn2, npis412, npgr412)

hhi_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "C2020_A") |>
  clean_names() |>
  semi_join(inst_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  filter(awlevel == 5) |>
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |>
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |>
  summarise(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |>
  summarise(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |>
  ungroup()

master_2020 <- inst_2020 |>
  left_join(ret_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(aid_p1_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(aid_p2_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(hhi_2020, by = "unitid") |>
  add_net_price_by_control() |>
  mutate(academic_year = "2020-21")

odbcClose(con)
save(master_2020, file = "../data/master_2020.RData")
```

# 2023-2024 Data Extraction

```{r}
#| label: 2023-2024-ingestion
#| cache: true
db_path_2023 <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS202324.accdb")
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path_2023)

inst_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2023") |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(as.integer(iclevel) == 1L, as.integer(control) %in% four_year_control_codes) |>
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr, control)

ret_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2023D") |>
  clean_names() |>
  semi_join(inst_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf)

# Net price is in SFA2223_P2 for this release; ensure unitid column exists.
aid_p1_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA2223_P2") |>
  clean_names(numerals = "asis")

# a bit of defensive coding because they changed unitid to unit_id for just some tables
# :(
if (!"unitid" %in% names(aid_p1_2023) && "unit_id" %in% names(aid_p1_2023)) {
  aid_p1_2023 <- aid_p1_2023 |> rename(unitid = unit_id)
}
if (!"unitid" %in% names(aid_p1_2023) && "cgunitid" %in% names(aid_p1_2023)) {
  aid_p1_2023 <- aid_p1_2023 |> rename(unitid = cgunitid)
}
aid_p1_2023 <- aid_p1_2023 |>
  semi_join(inst_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  normalize_sfa_net_price_cols() |>
  select(unitid, npist2, npgrn2, npis412, npgr412)

aid_p2_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA2223_P1") |>
  clean_names(numerals = "asis")
if (!"unitid" %in% names(aid_p2_2023) && "unit_id" %in% names(aid_p2_2023)) {
  aid_p2_2023 <- aid_p2_2023 |> rename(unitid = unit_id)
}
if (!"unitid" %in% names(aid_p2_2023) && "cgunitid" %in% names(aid_p2_2023)) {
  aid_p2_2023 <- aid_p2_2023 |> rename(unitid = cgunitid)
}
aid_p2_2023 <- aid_p2_2023 |>
  semi_join(inst_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  select(unitid, pell_pct = upgrntp)

hhi_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "C2023_A") |>
  clean_names() |>
  semi_join(inst_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  filter(awlevel == 5) |>
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |>
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |>
  summarise(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |>
  summarise(hhi_score = sum(share^2), .groups = "drop")

master_2023 <- inst_2023 |>
  left_join(ret_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(aid_p1_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(aid_p2_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  left_join(hhi_2023, by = "unitid") |>
  add_net_price_by_control() |>
  mutate(academic_year = "2023-24")

odbcClose(con)
save(master_2023, file = "../data/master_2023.RData")
```

```{r}
#| label: master-dataset

# final combination of all years, ensuring years are ordered
master_data <- bind_rows(
  master_2019,
  master_2020,
  master_2021,
  master_2022,
  master_2023
) |>
  mutate(
    academic_year = factor(
      academic_year,
      levels = c("2019-20", "2020-21", "2021-22", "2022-23", "2023-24")
    )
  )

save(master_data, file = "../data/master_data.RData")
write_csv(master_data, "../data/master_data.csv")
```
